Canonicalized from: `archive/change-records/2026-07-16-projects-folder-structure-update.md`

## Summary

The workspace's physical `Projects` layout has been standardized to three top-level domains: `Applications`, `Services`, and `Tooling`. This file records the current physical structure and recommended follow-ups for aligning historical architecture documents with the new physical layout.

## Current Physical Structure (observed 2026-07-16)

See the archived snapshot for the full observed tree: `archive/change-records/2026-07-16-projects-folder-structure-update.md`.

## Recommended Follow-Up

- Update architecture-evolution files that still use `Core/Infrastructure/Tenant` as physical-path examples.
- Add a concise note in architecture docs that conceptual layering and physical folder grouping intentionally differ.
- Treat `Projects/{Applications,Services,Tooling}` as the canonical physical structure baseline.
